metadata.reference: Shënojnë Ahmedi 5/82 dhe Nesaiu në “Amel el-Jevmi ve Lejleh” fq.218, nr. 421 me recensimin e dr. Faruk Hamades.

translations.english: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis  said: ‘I went to see the Prophet  and ate from his food and then said to him: (May Allah forgive you, O Messenger of Allah.) he  replied: (and you.))
translations.indonesian: Begitu juga kamu." 218 Doa Untuk Orang Yang Berbuat Baik
